question: Does learning BYTE/TOKEN selection and discrete code values improve causal held-out byte prediction beyond continuous latent patches and controls that do not learn gate weights?
nonclaims: No trained token identities or useful switching demonstrated
No semantic concept discovery, lossless code-only tokenization, general intelligence or architecture-superiority claim
No inference cost improvement from recurrent event counts alone
No fabricated corpus hashes, signatures, source rights, budget receipts or sealed-TEST custody

prior_art.paper: Byte Latent Transformer: Patches Scale Better Than Tokens
prior_art.reuse: Byte-local encoding/decoding and patch-level processing are established; S004 is not a faithful BLT implementation.

prior_art.paper: Dynamic Chunking for End-to-End Hierarchical Sequence Modeling
prior_art.reuse: End-to-end content-dependent hierarchical chunking is established; these small GRU candidates are not H-Net reproductions.
Discrete latent codebooks and straight-through training are established; the S005 estimator is not asserted identical to VQ-VAE.

arm_contracts.dense_byte: 118-wide GRU with current-byte readout; no unused pending-token columns or learned routing head; 100688 trainable/deployed weights
arm_contracts.forced_token: S005 with TOKEN forced and gate weights frozen; 100832 trainable, 101008 deployed
arm_contracts.adaptive_latent: Original S004 continuous patch pathway; 100752 trainable/deployed
arm_contracts.adaptive_codebook: Original S005 learned gate/codebook pathway; 101008 trainable/deployed
arm_contracts.frozen_gate_weights: S005 gate weights stay at paired initialization; encoder/state inputs can still learn, so this does not freeze its eventual decisions; 100832 trainable, 101008 deployed
arm_contracts.random_gate: S005 with a parameter-free exogenous gate; 100832 trainable/deployed; explicit independent uniform draws per source/position; frozen FIT-only calibration required

input_boundary.model_inputs: BOS then previously observed bytes only; sequence rows reset state
input_boundary.random_control_draws: Independent external RNG schedule, not target-derived; freeze probability using FIT-only source-qualified calibration before any comparison fit; calibration work charged and replayed
input_boundary.targets: Original next source bytes delivered only to the loss/scorer after prediction; aligned shift asserted
input_boundary.state: S004/S005 full-prefix recurrent computation, no cross-sequence state carry; this study cannot establish persistent cross-session learning

data.source_requirement: Publisher/version/licence/full original hashes; group-disjoint FIT/DEV/sealed TEST; exact/near-duplicate and boilerplate audit; source order and sample exposure frozen before fit
data.prior_exposed_diagnostics: All S001-S005 diagnostic source bytes, including exposed CPython prefixes, remain DEV/exposed; never reclassify as sealed TEST
data.holdout_requirement: Independent new source groups and an out-of-domain slice; multiple files from one repository do not establish domain generalization

training.objective: Mean next-byte cross entropy in nats; straight-through surrogate for adaptive arms; no invented reward or recurrent-event penalty in the primary comparison
training.selection_rule: DEV-only checks at steps 0,256,512,1024,1536,2048; lowest mean original-byte NLL, earliest checkpoint on exact ties; identical source/exposure opportunities for all arms; TEST excluded
training.note: Missing numerical budgets are blockers. No fabricated equal-FLOP figures and no dummy work to manufacture parity. If exposure/steps/compute cannot all match, preserve separately labelled analyses and withhold a fully matched architecture win. CPU wall time is an outcome, not a parity condition.
training.budget_status: REVIEWABLE_PROPOSAL_NOT_SOURCE_QUALIFIED_OR_PROFILED; no tuning or fits authorized; realized resource feasibility and strict parity still OPEN

evaluation.primary: Held-out bits per original byte, aggregated from total NLL and original byte count; no per-token denominator
evaluation.planned_gate: Adaptive discrete vs continuous latent: at least 0.02 BPB gain, paired seed CI excluding zero, at least four of five positive seeds, conditional on all source/resource/integrity gates
evaluation.routing_attribution: Compare adaptive codebook with frozen-gate-weights and independently randomized calibrated controls on identical source; report whether routing gain survives both
evaluation.decision_sampling: Frozen source-hash/position schedule on authorized DEV only, independent of targets; reject unavailable full horizons rather than silently truncate
evaluation.decision_regret: Teacher-forced internal BYTE/TOKEN forks with policy continuation; realized hindsight loss is not expected optimality or a causal external action effect; report ties separately
evaluation.code_causality: Freeze baseline routing and selector keys; replace code VALUES only. Joint key/value row permutation is a relabelling negative control, subject to argmax ties/numerics
evaluation.code_reuse: Occupancy, effective code count, dominant share and novel-sequence effects; occupancy alone is not semantic reuse
evaluation.bypass: Separate local-byte readout knockout required on actual trained checkpoint; clearly label possible distribution shift and do not claim removal of all byte processing
evaluation.efficiency: Original-byte throughput, full forward/backward profiler coverage, controller/entropy/pooling/selection/candidate GRUs/byte head/audit overhead, peak memory and end-to-end latency on recorded hardware
evaluation.uncertainty: Publish all five paired seeds and source-group uncertainty separately; freeze interval construction and any multiplicity handling before unsealing TEST
evaluation.checkpoint: Preserve initialization/final hashes, optimizer/sample-order/RNG state and exact replay; trusted independent postfit receipt binds every arm and seed
